import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static String process(String s) {
        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
        result.append(s.charAt(0)); // keep first character unchanged
        // Process from index 1
        boolean atReplaced = false;
        int i = 1;
        while (i < s.length()) {
            if (!atReplaced && i + 1 < s.length() && s.charAt(i) == 'a' && s.charAt(i + 1) == 't') {
                result.append('@');
                i += 2;
                atReplaced = true;
            } else if (i + 2 < s.length() && s.charAt(i) == 'd' && s.charAt(i + 1) == 'o' && s.charAt(i + 2) == 't') {
                result.append('.');
                i += 3;
            } else {
                result.append(s.charAt(i));
                i++;
            }
        }
        return result.toString();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        while (scanner.hasNext()) {
            String s = scanner.next();
            System.out.println(process(s));
        }
        scanner.close();
    }
}
